title: AI nuclear power firm Fermi finally has a new CEO
excerpt: Lee McIntire, an independent member of Fermi's board, has been hired as CEO, more than three months since the company fired co-founder Toby Neugebauer from the top post.
content_html:
In Brief

Posted:

3:24 PM PDT · August 12, 2026

Fermi, the AI nuclear power firm, has named a new CEO more than three months after firing co-founder Toby Neugebauer from the top executive post.

Fermi said Wednesday it has hired Lee McIntire, an independent member of the company’s board who has held chief executive positions at CH2M Hill and TerraPower, the nuclear power startup founded by Bill Gates.

Fermi America, which was co-founded by former U.S. Energy Secretary Rick Perry, is developing an AI campus in Amarillo, Texas, called Project Matador that will eventually use nuclear reactors to power data centers.

The announcement, along with Monday’s news that it had signed TensorWave as its first binding customer lease for its Project Matador campus, provided a welcome boost to Fermi’s stock. (The stock is up nearly 23% since Monday.) The young company took a hit in April when Neugebauer and CFO Miles Everson were pushed out of the company. At the time, the company described the executive shakeup, along with other plans including a corporate headquarters in Dallas, as Fermi 2.0.

“Fermi’s next chapter is a construction and power delivery story, and we believe Lee is the ideal executive to lead Fermi through that process,” Marius Haas, Fermi’s chairman of the board, said in a statement. “The job now is to build on schedule, on budget, and safely. Lee has spent 40 years delivering exactly this kind of large, complex project. He also knows Fermi from the inside, having served on our board through our latest period of growth, and he brings a reputation for integrity that Fermi’s customers, employees, regulators, and neighbors can rely on.”

content_html_zh:
简介

发布：

太平洋夏令时间下午 3:24 · 2026 年 8 月 12 日

人工智能核电公司费米 (Fermi) 在解雇联合创始人托比·诺伊格鲍尔 (Toby Neugebauer) 最高执行职务三个多月后，任命了新首席执行官。

Fermi 周三表示，已聘请公司董事会独立成员 Lee McIntire，他曾在 CH2M Hill 和比尔·盖茨创立的核电初创公司 TerraPower 担任首席执行官。

Fermi America 由美国前能源部长里克·佩里 (Rick Perry) 联合创立，正在德克萨斯州阿马里洛开发一个名为斗牛士项目的人工智能园区，最终将使用核反应堆为数据中心供电。

这一消息，加上周一宣布签署 TensorWave 作为其 Project Matador 园区首个具有约束力的客户租赁的消息，为 Fermi 的股价带来了可喜的提振。 （自周一以来，该股已上涨近 23%。） 四月份，当纽格鲍尔和首席财务官迈尔斯·埃弗森被赶出公司时，这家年轻的公司遭受了打击。 当时，该公司将这次高管改组以及包括在达拉斯设立公司总部在内的其他计划称为“费米 2.0”。

费米董事会主席马吕斯·哈斯在一份声明中表示：“费米的下一章是建筑和电力输送故事，我们相信李是领导费米完成这一过程的理想高管。” “现在的工作是按计划、按预算、安全地进行建设。 Lee 花了 40 年的时间来完成这种大型、复杂的项目。 他还从内部了解费米，在我们最近的发展时期一直在我们的董事会任职，他为费米的客户、员工、监管机构和邻居带来了值得信赖的诚信声誉。”
